 Food News Dining Guides Food Files Health & Wellness Recipes $15 Deals Table Talk Sound Bites Reviews Add Daily Memphian to Home Screen Metro Mid-South Food Bank scrambles to fill the gap as SNAP rules tighten 
 By Brandon LaGrone II , Daily Memphian Published: November 08, 2026 4:00 AM CT The Mid-South Food Bank warehouse is at 3865 S. Perkins Road. (Brandon LaGrone II/The Daily Memphian)
 Under new federal rules, states with SNAP payment error rates over 6% will be liable for the costs of those mistakes. As Tennessee grows more cautious, families feel the pinch.

 Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program SNAP Mid-South Food Bank Brandon LaGrone II
 Brandon LaGrone Jr. is a Bluff City native who has earned an undergraduate degree in journalism from LSU’s Manship School. He’s written for publications including The (Baton Rouge) Advocate and The Atlanta Journal-Constitution.
